chapters.title: Projects & Innovations
chapters.subtitle: Mobile POS, AI Recommendation & E-Commerce
chapters.narrative:
I have engineered impactful projects including:
• Internship Recommendation System: AI-powered platform to recommend internships based on skills and interests.
• Mobile POS: Offline billing & inventory app with barcode scanning, GST/discount calculation, Cash & UPI payments, PDF/CSV reports, and thermal receipt printing.
• RARO – Online Shopping App: Flutter e-commerce app featuring product discovery, categories, deals, secure payments, and a responsive shopping experience.
chapters.quote: Building applications that deliver practical value and seamless user experiences.
